summary: Completed testing of configurable location URL slug prefix feature. All critical features working: /api/locations/commercial-cleaning-robots-missouri resolves (200), backward compatibility with /api/locations/custom-sublimation-missouri works (200), all prefix aliases resolve correctly, dev settings endpoint requires auth (401 as expected), frontend location pages load without 404 errors.

_parse_location_request() properly iterates through known prefixes for backward compatibility
_known_location_prefixes() correctly builds ordered list with active prefix first
serve_generated_page() endpoint correctly handles multiple prefix candidates
LocationPage.jsx buildSlugCandidates() correctly generates fallback candidates for frontend fetch
DevLocationGenerator.jsx properly implements slug prefix input field and save action with data-testid attributes
